dispositions.finding: E2 (engine, minor): words-version mismatch in the export job showed 'The PDF could not be printed.', was retried twice and held the singleton
dispositions.how: c5eb6ddd. The failure code IS constrained by the database: trigger audit_event_packet_export_attempt checks purpose against packet_export_failure_codes() (migration 20261103090000, lines 1512-1535). So the code stays render_failed. packetExportHandler now records packet_export_failed at once (the last try), logs PACKET_EXPORT_WORDS_CHANGED and returns without throwing, so there is no retry and the singleton is freed. EXPORT_FAILURE_TEXT.render_failed now names the cause, and the page's 'Ask for the export again' gives the remedy. PacketExportWordsVersionError was removed. dispositions.finding: E3 (engine, minor): WORDS_VERSION could be bypassed by a sentence edit without a RENDERER_REVISION bump
dispositions.how: 3428aefa. New test packages/packets/src/explain/sentence-forms.test.ts pins the SHA-256 of explain/line.ts, worksheet.ts and figures.ts beside the revision. Any edit fails until RENDERER_REVISION is raised (which moves WORDS_VERSION) and the pin is rewritten. It is excluded from mutation runs in vitest.mutation.config.ts, as purity.test.ts is, because Stryker rewrites the source. RENDERER_REVISION is 3, WORDS_VERSION is 4e9fac65..., and the golden pins were rewritten with vitest -u.

dispositions.finding: U3 (UX, major): step numbering had two 'Step 2's, NCCI PTP and Per visit fell back to labels, and the viewer skipped Step 4
dispositions.how: bad4c48f. TITLES now read 'Step 2, continued: the fee schedule', 'Step 3, continued: the per-visit amount' and 'Step 3, continued: National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) procedure-to-procedure edits'. I used 'Step 3, continued' rather than the reviewer's 'Step 2, continued' for per-visit because the trace orders it after units. dispositions.how: 3428aefa: the payer's observed step states the basis only; rounding reads 'X needed no rounding.' when the unrounded and rounded texts are equal. b0bf52fd: the PDF's Patient share column is dropped, because the words carry it on all three surfaces and builder/review have no such column. dispositions.finding: U7 (UX, minor): bare codes in the internal and viewer words
dispositions.how: 3428aefa. MUE and NCCI are written out at use ('medically unlikely edit (MUE)', 'National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits'). The Adjustments table lists each.', and an adjustment of another group is refused. AMT B6 reads 'the allowed amount the payer states for the line (AMT B6)'. The NCCI PTP title is fixed in bad4c48f.

dispositions.finding: U9 (UX, minor): the Other runs list dropped the unpriced reason
dispositions.how: 5da8e366. New otherRunReasonText() in lib/contracts/remedies.ts gives the reason's meaning word for word, with SECONDARY_PAYER worded as the engine stops it. It is shown as ', not priced: ...', data-reason is kept, and remedies.test covers it.

dispositions.finding: U10 (UX, nit): the PDF calculation table's caption and header row were cut at the foot of page 2
dispositions.how: b0bf52fd. CSS break rules in apps/worker/src/packets/html.ts: h2, h3 and caption break-after avoid; thead is table-header-group with break-after avoid; the first row has break-before avoid; rows have break-inside avoid. The rules are scoped to table:not(.pages). I reproduced the cut by padding the narrative (2 to 4 filler lines) before the fix; it is gone after. A new print-layout.test checks that the caption, header and row 1 share a page for 0 to 8 filler lines. No packet print baseline exists in the repo to regenerate.

dispositions.finding: U11 (UX, nit): counts printed without a thousands separator
dispositions.how: 3428aefa: new 'integer' figure form (grouped by regex, no arithmetic) used for window.length, and count is grouped too; test-support's independent formatter and number tokenizer accept grouped integers. b0bf52fd: the worker's counted() is grouped ('3,650 days'). Covered by figures.test, line.test, line-words-routes.db.test and export.test.
